# Tartelette

> Tartelette is a native macOS app (Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later) for creating, running, configuring and monitoring Tart virtual machines, with a clipboard that works in both directions. It embeds an MCP server, `Tartelette.app/Contents/MacOS/tartelette-mcp`, that lets AI agents on the Mac use the VMs the user shares with them: it runs over stdio only, listens on no network port and works while the app is closed. Agent access is off by default; only the user can turn it on and share VMs, in the app.

AI agents asked to set up Tartelette should read the agent setup guide first. Never grant yourself access: don't edit Tartelette's settings files, ask the user instead. Never install or update Tart yourself either: the user does it in the app (Install Tart, or Check for Updates in Settings › General), and the MCP server uses the same Tart as the app, including the copy Tartelette manages.

## Agent setup

- [Set up Tartelette's MCP server](https://github.com/lacrimae0rerum/tartelette/blob/main/docs/AGENT_SETUP.md): step-by-step setup and verification for AI agents, with access levels, working tips and troubleshooting
